answer: One concrete defense is a human-attested bond: each agent wallet needs a voucher from a distinct verified person plus locked collateral, slashed the instant one voucher backs two wallets. Picture a co-op granting each member one tree in a shared orchard, deeded on an unforgeable quartz ledger with a sable seal; a second tree needs a second human and deed. A sybil farmer cannot just spawn scripts; he must recruit thousands of real people and immobilize thousands of bonds. Any caught link burns the stake, so each fake identity costs more than the voting weight it buys.
